notes.title: Patch Notes 1.03
notes.notes:
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added languages ​​- French, German, and Spanish have been added
[*] Add skip
     - You can quickly scroll through the location text, newspaper evaluation, and newspaper rankings when they are displayed.
     - You can skip events or skip conversations in cleared chapters.
       (Events with major choices that affect the ending can only be skipped during conversation)
[*] Retry added
     - If you try again after the game is over, you can skip the event or skip the conversation.
[*] Improved conversation UI
     - The editor-in-chief's name is displayed when chatting.
     - The editor-in-chief's monologue, dialogue text, public text, and minigame text are displayed aligned to the left.
     - Optional, hide the face image of the character when the editor-in-chief speaks
[*] Free editing - The number of text characters that can be entered in the newspaper name and article title has been increased
[/list]

[b]Bug fix[/b]
[list]
[*] Some text changes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note 1.01
notes.notes:
[i]Hello, this is Decatree Games.
As soon as it was released, I participated in Gamescom Asia, so the patch was very late.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused while playing due to the bug.
And thank you for your interest and valuable opinion.
Please leave additional improvements, bug reports, etc. on the Steam Community or send us an email.
Best regards,
Decatree Games[/i]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Japanese has been added
[*]You can achieve the Master Editor achievement
[*]A new article title has been added to Chapter 8 (Dilemma)
[list]
[*] Depending on the direction of the article title,
     the next branching point becomes clearer and more natural.
[/list][*]Added ‘fast forward’ button
[list]
[*]Now, if you clear the chapter and play again, a ‘fast forward’ button will appear at the bottom right during the conversation.
[*] Pressing the ‘fast forward’ button makes the conversation 8 times faster
[/list][*]Preferences > The conversation auto-progress feature has been changed to be disabled at first startup.
[*]credit
[list]
[*] Nicknames of Tumblbug sponsors have been added.
[*] Modified the credits to flow more slowly than before
[/list][*] Fixed the background image to not flicker when gameover.
[*] The facial expressions of some characters have been changed to match the dialogue.
[*] Fixed the issue where the voice and dialogue text were different.
[*] Corrected spelling, spacing, etc.
[/list]
[b]Bug fix[/b]
[list]
[*] During an event (opening, ending, dialogue, etc.), go to Settings > ‘To title screen’
     Fixed an issue where the game did not proceed properly
[list]
[*]The original intention was that preferences could not be loaded during the opening and ending. Modified the preferences to be unavailable
[*]The original intention was to hide the Settings > ‘To Title Screen’ button during a conversation. The 'To title screen' button has been modified to not be visible.
[*]I tried to keep the ‘To Title Screen’ button whenever possible. It was expected that development would take a lot of time, so we modified it as originally intended.
[/list][*]Improved the phenomenon of stopping during newspaper publishing
[/list]
